title: PAIR-MED: Policy-reward Alternation for Iterative Refinement in Multilingual Medical Reasoning
title_zh: PAIR-MED：通过策略与奖励模型交替训练迭代改进多语言医学推理
abstract_en: Large language models demonstrate strong medical question-answering capabilities, yet reasoning performance remains uneven across languages. Process reward models (PRMs) provide step-level feedback for improving reasoning, but a fixed PRM may become increasingly misaligned with the trajectory distribution of an evolving policy during reinforcement learning, thereby reducing the reliability of its supervision. We propose a policy--reward alternating training framework that jointly adapts a medical PRM and optimizes a multilingual reasoning policy. Following supervised initialization, the current policy generates multilingual trajectories to update the PRM, which then provides process-level rewards for the next policy update. Medical step supervision maintains the PRM's medical foundation, while process, outcome, and language-related rewards guide policy learning. We develop multilingual medical PRMs (PAIR-PRM) and reasoning models (PAIR-MED) at 8B and 9B scales across 12 languages. On the medical subsets of Global-MMLU and MMLU-ProX, our models improve average accuracy by 3.01--7.47% over their corresponding Qwen backbones. On CUREMED-BENCH, PAIR-MED-9B improves the joint language consistency and logical accuracy metric by 12.88% and 7.45% over baselines for in-domain and out-of-domain languages. Further analyses examine PRM adaptation, multilingual reasoning quality, and the contributions of individual training components.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型在医学问答中表现出色，但推理能力因语言而异。过程奖励模型（PRM）可提供逐步反馈，但在强化学习中，固定的 PRM 可能逐渐与不断演进的策略所生成的推理轨迹分布失配，导致监督信号的可靠性下降。PAIR-MED 采用策略与奖励模型交替训练框架：在监督初始化后，当前策略生成多语言推理轨迹以更新医学 PRM，更新后的 PRM 再为下一轮策略优化提供过程奖励。医学推理步骤的监督用于维持 PRM 的医学知识基础，策略则由过程奖励、结果奖励和语言相关奖励共同引导。研究构建了覆盖 12 种语言、参数规模为 8B 和 9B 的医学 PRM（PAIR-PRM）与推理模型（PAIR-MED）。在 Global-MMLU 和 MMLU-ProX 的医学子集上，模型的平均准确率较对应的 Qwen 基座模型提高 3.01%–7.47%。在 CUREMED-BENCH 上，PAIR-MED-9B 的语言一致性与逻辑准确性联合指标相较基线在域内和域外语言上分别提高 12.88% 和 7.45%。
key_points_zh: 核心问题：策略在强化学习中不断变化，固定的过程奖励模型可能无法可靠评估新策略生成的推理步骤。
核心方法：用当前策略生成的多语言轨迹更新 PAIR-PRM，再用更新后的过程奖励优化策略；医学步骤监督维持奖励模型的医学知识基础。
模型覆盖 12 种语言，提供 8B 和 9B 两种规模；在 Global-MMLU 和 MMLU-ProX 医学子集上，平均准确率较对应 Qwen 基座提高 3.01%–7.47%。
在 CUREMED-BENCH 上，PAIR-MED-9B 的语言一致性与逻辑准确性联合指标较基线在域内和域外语言上分别提高 12.88% 和 7.45%。
